m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Do you think this might be it? Too crafty, the White Razors said. :Tsssk:
:Tsssk: These fragments are from some strange vessel. Whoever, or whatever, lives here is in a wretched state. Be on your guard.
And now the storm blast came, and he was tyrannous and strong! He struck with his o'ertaking wings, and chased us south along!
What madness is this? Spellbinder, defend yourself!
Down dropt the breeze, the sails dropt down, 'Twas sad as sad could be; And we did speak only to break the silence of the sea!
More gibberish. This wretch is of no use to us. Let us end his pain.
There is a rabid creature that prowls around Crescent Beach. Perhaps some kind of diseased Burrower. He's stolen from us many times.
My forces should have exterminated him by now, but... they have been unable to catch or corner him.
I believe his den is somewhere near the Skull Rock, but we have not found it. He is too crafty! Good luck trying to track him down!
Good luck trying to track down the mad Rat! Search around the Skull Rock, though I doubt you will ever even find that!
